note: SCSS/Less Compiler compiles .scss/.less declared in *.libraries.yml into CSS via the bundled scssphp library, driven by the scss_compiler.settings config object (keys: output_format compressed|expanded|nested|compact|crunched, sourcemaps, cache, check_modify_time, flush_cache_type default|system, node_modules_path, and plugins = an extension->compiler-id map, default {scss: scss_compiler_scssphp}). It defines a plugin type 'scss_compiler' (manager plugin.manager.scss_compiler; shipped compilers scss_compiler_scssphp, scss_compiler_lessphp, scss_compiler_libsass) and a Drush command compiler:cr (alias ccr) that flushes/recompiles. Settings are exposed on the core Performance form (configure: system.performance_settings). Recompile route /admin/flush/scss_compiler. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config and the real service: introspection reads output_format and the plugins map; execution sets output_format+plugins.less and actually compiles a .scss file to .css via \Drupal::service('scss_compiler')->compile(). scssphp is installed under vendor/. Shipped baseline: output_format compressed, plugins {scss: scss_compiler_scssphp}.

evals.prompt: In the scss_compiler module, which scss_compiler.settings key controls the compiled CSS output style, and what are its valid values?
evals.expected_output: The 'output_format' key of scss_compiler.settings. Valid values are compressed (default), expanded, nested, compact and crunched; each maps to a scssphp formatter class, and an unrecognised value falls back to compressed.

evals.prompt: How do I force the scss_compiler module to recompile all SCSS sources from the command line, and is there an admin route to do the same?
evals.expected_output: Run drush compiler:cr (alias drush ccr), which calls the service flushCache() to delete public://scss_compiler and recompile everything. The admin route /admin/flush/scss_compiler (scss_compiler.flush) does the same and redirects back; a normal drush cr also triggers a flush.

evals.prompt: How does the scss_compiler module know which files to compile, and which plugin compiles .scss by default? How would I also compile .less?
evals.expected_output: Declare the .scss/.less file in a *.libraries.yml css section; hook_library_info_alter/hook_css_alter then compile any file whose extension is a key in scss_compiler.settings:plugins. The default map is {scss: scss_compiler_scssphp}. To compile .less, add less: scss_compiler_lessphp to the plugins map.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the live scss_compiler configuration and tell me what CSS output style (output format) the compiler is currently set to produce.
evals.expected_output: It is set to 'expanded' (scss_compiler.settings:output_format = expanded), i.e. human-readable multi-line CSS rather than the default compressed output.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the scss_compiler module has been configured to compile .less files. Inspect the live configuration and tell me which compiler plugin handles the .less extension.
evals.expected_output: The .less extension is mapped to the scss_compiler_lessphp (LessPHP) compiler in scss_compiler.settings:plugins (plugins.less = scss_compiler_lessphp).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the scss_compiler module so that (1) compiled CSS is human-readable 'expanded' output, and (2) .less files are compiled using the LessPHP plugin. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set scss_compiler.settings:output_format to 'expanded' and add plugins.less = 'scss_compiler_lessphp' (e.g. drush cset scss_compiler.settings output_format expanded; drush cset scss_compiler.settings plugins.less scss_compiler_lessphp).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a SCSS source file at /tmp/scss_compiler-eval/style.scss. Using the scss_compiler module's service (\Drupal::service('scss_compiler')), compile it into CSS at /tmp/scss_compiler-eval/style.css on the live site.
evals.expected_output: Call \Drupal::service('scss_compiler')->compile(['source_path' => '/tmp/scss_compiler-eval/style.scss', 'css_path' => '/tmp/scss_compiler-eval/style.css', 'namespace' => 'olivero', 'name' => 'style', 'assets_path' => ''], TRUE); The written CSS contains the compiled nested rule '.box .title{color:#123456}'.
